Provenance

Data & method

This is an independent, static atlas of the unions in the BBS 2022 Union Statistics. It is not an official BBS product.

What is in the atlas

unions across upazilas, districts and divisions. indicators come from three BBS tables: households and population, literacy and technology, and SDG indicators.

National totals in the source: people and households.

Source

Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS), Population and Housing Census 2022, Union Statistics. Tables U01 (pp. 95–210), U02 (pp. 211–356) and U03 (pp. 357–462).

Open the source PDF
SHA-256

How the data was collected

  1. The BBS PDF was downloaded and checksummed.
  2. Tables were parsed with pdfplumber, without OCR, page by page.
  3. Rows were reconciled against the U02 union roster, names canonicalised, and duplicate or missing rows checked.
  4. Each value was linked back to its source page; every profile exposes those page links.

How boundaries were joined

Union polygons come from BBS administrative boundaries distributed through the bangladesh R package (MIT). Census rows were matched hierarchically by division, district and upazila, then by fuzzy union name. of unions matched (). unions have census data but no boundary shape; they remain searchable, listed and downloadable.

The map also contains municipal or ward polygons that have no census union row. They are drawn with a hatch and are not counted as unions.

Validation

  • 4,584 union rows in each of U01, U02 and U03; 0 duplicate keys.
  • 495/495 upazila totals and 64/64 district totals reconcile.
  • Male + female = total; percentages fall within 0–100; no missing merged values.
  • Household definitions differ between tables: U02 hh_total includes floating households; U01 hh_total_excl_floating does not.

Limits

  • 284 unions lack a boundary shape and are not drawn on the map.
  • Boundary labels sometimes differ from census names; the census name is shown, with the boundary label noted.
  • Values are reproduced as published; there is no modelling or imputation.
  • Percentages are not causal estimates and may use different denominators by table.

Cite

Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (2022). Population and Housing Census 2022, Union Statistics. Dhaka: BBS. Boundary data: BBS via the bangladesh R package.

Download

CSV files are generated in your browser from the embedded data. No request is sent anywhere.

This page is self-contained: no external fonts, tiles, trackers or API calls. It works offline after the first load.
